Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the next steps I promised to send over:

Key decision criteria you flagged:
- Latency and consistency under 95th percentile production load
- Data residency + audit logging for payments data
- Cost predictability (monthly committed capacity vs burst)

Stakeholder map (as discussed):
- Economic buyer: Carlos Mendes (Head of Finance) \u2014 cares about TCO and contract terms
- Security / Compliance: Lena Ortiz (Security Lead) \u2014 SOC 2, data retention, KMS/HSM
- Procurement / Legal: TBD (you mentioned procurement team gets looped after budget sign)
- Technical eval: Rafael Mendes (your infra lead) \u2014 will run the integration POC

Attached is a first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) table with proposed milestones, owners, and target dates (FinPay_MAP_v1.xlsx).

Proposed next steps:
1) You to confirm procurement/legal contact and Carlos as economic buyer (by Fri 11/27)
2) Redwood to share security questionnaire responses (sent here as a PDF) and schedule a 30-min security review with Lena (target next week)
3) Tech deep-dive + POC kickoff with Rafael and David (Redwood solutions engineer) \u2014 proposed Wed 12/2 at 10am PT

If that all looks right I can formalize the MAP and convert the milestones into HubSpot tasks so we can track them.

Thanks \u2014
